notes.title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed gets a couple of Steam Deck fixes
notes.notes:
While Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed was already rated Steam Deck Verified by Valve, it's nice to see developers still making improvements to it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/disney-epic-mickey-rebrushed-gets-a-couple-of-steam-deck-fixes/

notes.title: Steam Deck Update!
notes.notes:
Today we launched a small patch to fix some steam deck issues, changelog is as follows:

[olist]
[*] - Excluded user settings from Steam Cloud saves; meaning Steam Deck and PC use separate user settings from now on
[*] - Fixed initial start up resolution setting on Steam Deck
[/olist]

notes.title: Second patch now live!
notes.notes:
We have just launched a second patch for the game.

Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with extra content movies not getting unlocked correctly
[*] Fixed various quest progression issues from occurring
[*] Fixed an issue with the "An Epic Journey" and "Out of my way" achievements/trophies not triggering correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Blue House" concept art sketch not being awarded under specific circumstances
[*] Fixed gargoyles that caused mickey to get stuck on them.
[*] Various Audio fixes and improvements
[*] Spelling and localisation fixes and improvements
[/list]

As a little bonus (maybe a late birthday present?), Trading Cards have been added as well.

notes.title: Purple Lamp‘s faithful remake Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/e8b9a9fc23b5fb3131d0b16ff735b278c88e473b.png[/img]

[h2]Epic Mickey is Back! Unleash the Power of the Brush in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed — Available NOW[/h2]
 
Vienna, Austria - September 24, 2024: The wait is over! Epic Mickey is back, and this time, the stakes are truly epic! Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, the highly anticipated remake of the beloved classic, developed by Purple Lamp in collaboration with Disney Games and published by THQ Nordic, is now available on Nintendo® Switch, PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

Watch the release trailer here: https://youtu.be/uI5t2oXQSAg

Mickey Mouse’s adventure with magic ink has gone awry, and he soon finds himself pulled into the dangerous world of Wasteland, a realm where forgotten Disney characters reside. In Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, players will step into Mickey’s shoes and take control of his magical brush to restore the world around him or use paint and thinner to reshape the environment and uncover hidden secrets.

Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed brings the classic 2010 game back and for the first time ever, is available to modern consoles with enhanced visuals and graphics. New gameplay features include dash, ground pound and sprint allowing fans of the original and newcomers alike more ways to navigate Wasteland and combat enemies. Along with the magic paint brush, players can explore the unpredictable world of Wasteland, with levels inspired by classic Disney stories, and meet familiar faces along the way.

Get the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522160/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed/

Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is available now for Nintendo® Switch, PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC at an SRP of € 59.99 / $ 59.99 / £ 49.99 / AU$ 99.95 / ¥ 6578.

Not sure yet? Enjoy the great Steam demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043870/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed_Demo/

Follow @thqnordic for all Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed news and updates.

Enjoy & stay tuned!

notes.title: Back For Good: THQ Nordic Will Be At gamescom 2024!
notes.notes:
Whatever we said, whatever we did - we didn't mean it, we just will be back for good! We are thrilled to announce that after a year of absence, THQ Nordic is making a grand return to Cologne for gamescom 2024.

Get ready to immerse yourself in Germany's most iconic gaming franchise as the Gothic Remake will be playable at our booth. We eagerly await fans' feedback on this highly anticipated release!

[b]But that's not all! Attendees will also have the opportunity to play Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed. This remake of the 2010 beloved classic, originally envisioned by legendary game designer Warren Spector, takes Mickey Mouse on an epic journey through the Wasteland, a realm of forgotten Disney characters.[/b]

The excitement continues with Titan Quest II, an ARPG where you can be among the first in the world to embark on an odyssey for fame, loot, and XP.

We have two more titles playable in Cologne, but we’re keeping those under wraps for now. Stay tuned for their announcement just before gamescom opens on August 21st. Be sure to watch the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase on August 2nd, 2024, for all the details:

Check out the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2024 website: https://showcase.thqnordic.com/


[b]THQ Nordic's playable games at gamescom 2024, Hall 7.1, Booth A11/B10
- Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed[/b]
- Gothic Remake
- Titan Quest II
- "unannounced game #1"

[b]THQ Nordic's gamescom lineup will be streamed[/b]

Can't make it to Cologne? We've got you covered! THQ Nordic is teaming up with well-known content creators and international press outlets to stream live from our booth directly to your screens. Expect in-depth interviews with our developers and your favorite content creators streaming our games. As gamescom approaches, we’ll share more information about the participating channels and outlets.

Join us at gamescom 2024 for an unforgettable gaming experience!

notes.title: REVISIT A BELOVED CLASSIC WITH DISNEY EPIC MICKEY: REBRUSHED
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/e83b61797d7bb0c9496c9149352b839abe646436.jpg[/img]

[h2]REVISIT A BELOVED CLASSIC WITH DISNEY EPIC MICKEY: REBRUSHED[/h2]

[b]Embark on a magical adventure in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed – an enhanced remake of the 2010 classic![/b]
 
Vienna, Austria, February 21, 2024: THQ Nordic today announced that Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, a faithful remake of the beloved classic adventure, is being developed by Purple Lamp in collaboration with Disney Games. The development team was assisted in the remaster by Warren Spector, director of the original Disney Epic Mickey. In this classic action-adventure game, players will send Mickey Mouse, armed with a magical paintbrush, on an epic creative journey to brave the dangerous world of Wasteland. Through exciting levels inspired by classic Disney stories, players will paint their path and face a variety of challenges along the way. Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is scheduled for release across PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo® Switch and PC in 2024.

A first look at Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed can be found here: https://youtu.be/EF4XVQ0d5kk

“[i]I’ve received more heartfelt fan mail from players of all ages about Disney Epic Mickey than any other project I’ve worked on – a true indicator of the timelessness of this game,[/i]” said Warren Spector, director of the original Disney Epic Mickey. “[i]That my team and I contributed to that legacy is truly an honor and I’m delighted that old fans and new will get to enjoy the adventures of Mickey and Oswald in Wasteland once again.[/i]”

“[i]Having been part of this from the earliest beginnings of the creative idea, all those years ago, I can’t wait to see new players discover this enduring classic on modern consoles,[/i]” said Luigi Priore, V.P. of Disney, Pixar and 20th Century Games. “[i]We are excited that fans of the original will also get to relive their own experiences wielding the paintbrush and thinner once again.[/i]”

Make sure to wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522160/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed/

Follow @thqnordic for all Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed news and updates.

Enjoy & stay tuned!
